source: On recent ZXNAME0000XZ architectures, shared memory and L1 functionality can share or partition a unified on-chip data-cache resource, but the exact size and organization vary by compute capability. That implementation fact does not turn shared memory into an ordinary cache: the programmer still allocates and addresses shared memory explicitly.[1]
zh: 在最新的 ZXNAME0000XZ 架构上，共享内存和 L1 功能可以共享或分区统一的片上数据缓存资源，但确切的大小和组织因计算能力而异。该实现事实不会将共享内存转变为普通缓存：程序员仍然显式分配和寻址共享内存。[1]
